(In Rhet.) The hero of a poetic composition (a play or drama); (according to S. D. there are four main kinds of नायक: धीरोदात्त, धीरोद्धत, धीरललित, and धीरप्रशान्त, q. v.; these are again subdivided, the total number of kinds being 48; see S.
-75. The Rasamañjarī mentions 3 classes पति, उपपति, and वैशिक; 95.11).
